generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

Please note that the filled in Techno Commercial sheet shall be uploaded along with all the other QR documents. Percentage above / below / equal to the amount put to tender shall be quoted in the Financial bid offer, provisioned in the e-procurement portal. In case the prices are uploaded in/ along the Techno commercial bid, then bid will be summarily rejected. The Techno- commercial shall be uploaded in KPTCL excel formats only
Bidder shall not take any deviations on the clauses listed in the No Deviation Certificate(Annexure-I).

technicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should have carried out the work of erecting of 11kV Breakers of MCVCB type with U.G.Cables as per the tender document. Similar nature or type of works of the same voltage class or higher class of voltage specified in the scope of work or similar nature of work in KPTCL & ESCOMs undertakings etc during the previous 5 years FY 2020-21, 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25 and should be in successful operation for at least 1 year as on the date of bid opening.The bidder should have Mandating satisfactory completion for at least one similar work to an extent of 80percent of the cost of the work. The bidder should have Executed in any one Financial year, the minimum quantities of work usually 80percent of the peak annual rate of construction.

technicalCriterionList.description: The Tenderer/Bidder shall possess valid Super Grade Electrical Contractors License issued by the Government of Karnataka as on the date of Bid Submission and shall upload the same along with other Bidding documents failing which the offer will be rejected.
Consent & authorization letter from approved Vendor of KPTCL for technical support to be provided also to abide as per the guarantee clause of the material as per NIT.

The Tenderer shall be individual Proprietorship firm or Partnership firm or Private firm or Company Registered under Companies Act 1956/2013. Note: For other than proprietorship, the Bidder shall furnish the registered partnership deed and Power of Attorney.

Any Tenderer/ Bidder from a country which shares a land with India will be eligible to bid in this tender only if the Tenderer is registered with the Competent Authority. A certificate for having read the clauses specified in QR of the NIT of the tender documents under the heading Eligibility clauses in respect of restrictions on procurement from a Tenderer/Bidder of a country which shares a land border with India shall be uploaded by the Tenderer/Bidder.

Tenderers who meet the above specified minimum qualifying criteria, will only be qualified, if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value. The available tender capacity will be calculated as under, Assessed Available Tender Capacity (AxNx1.5- B) Where A Maximum value of works executed (KPTCL & Non-KPTCL) in any one year during the last five years (updated to FY 2025-2026) taking into account the completed as well as works in progress. N is Number of years prescribed for completion of the works for which tenders are invited. B is Value, at FY 2025-2026 price level of existing commitments (KPTCL & Non KPTCL) and on-going works (KPTCL & Non-KPTCL) to be completed during the next 1(One) years.

technicalCriterionList.description: To qualify for award of this contract, Tenderer in its name should have the following. In the last preceding five years i.e. FY 2021-2022 to FY 2025-2026 achieved in at least two financial years a minimum turnover of Rs. 3,93,88,688/-(usually not less than two times the estimated annual payments under this contract) in the last preceding five years i.e. FY 2021-2022 to FY 2025-2026. Bidder shall be financially sound and shall submit audited financial reports along with UDIN for last five years preceding the date of Bid submission. Bidder shall have adequate knowledge of Sub-Stations and Transmission Lines Design procedures including Quality Control and shall have infrastructure and Erection facilities and capacity to execute the Works.
